posts.title: Failed Quooker Cube
posts.description: I received a failed Quooker Cube chiller unit. Upon connection to power, nothing would happen; no lights, no sounds. Slightly weird board layout, with the main voltage conversion "primary" situated a significant distance from the mains input "power supply": Investigation revealed the voltage on the secondary capacitors was only around one volt. posts.description: I am personally opposed to async , futures, promises; whatever you call it. posts.title: Playing with prctl and seccomp
posts.description: I have been playing with low-level Linux security features, such as prctl no new privs and seccomp . These tools allow you to reduce the harm a process can do to your system. They're typically deployed as part of systemd, although the default settings in many distros are yet to be ideal .
